title: Trump, Xi and Putin to Hold First Three-Way Summit. Yalta 1945 Did It First #shorts
description:
This week Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin are due to hold their first three-way summit in China, on the sidelines of the APEC meeting in Shenzhen. In February 1945, Roosevelt, Churchill and Stalin met at Yalta to decide the shape of the postwar world.
